frames.source_quote: It may be more accurate and easier to just iterate to a solution. First you guess at a friction coefficient, insert it into your simulation, run your simulation, see if your result is higher or lower than amount you measured, then guess a new value and repeat until you feel that you are are close enough to your measured value.
